evidence.chosenTweaks: pasted-card-width=220px in the composer; sent and shared cards 320px (240px below 760px)
evidence.realChrome: Built-in browser against the rebuilt local API (migration 20261028_0029) with a local test user on localhost:5173: a 100-line paste became pasted-text-1.txt (220px composer card, input left empty, draft stored metadata with origin paste and no text); the dialog showed only the header with 100 行 · 5,264 字符; a 20,100-character prompt showed the red 20,100 / 20,000 counter, disabled send and 转为附件 turned it into pasted-text-2.txt (first_line stored at 120 characters, no 在输入框中显示 because it would not fit); a 4,510-character paste expanded back into the focused input via 在输入框中显示; the sent message bound origin paste, the model answered from the log, and after reload the 240px/320px card read the text through POST /files/{id}/text; the public share page showed the card from snapshot stats and read the text through POST /share/{token}/attachments/0-0/text.

scope: Long pastes (>= 4,000 characters or >= 80 lines) become pasted-text-N.txt attachments with origin paste; 220px composer card with 在输入框中显示; header-only full-text dialog; 320px/240px sent and shared cards; 80% character counter with 转为附件 over the limit; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V pastes inline.
exceptions: The ClamAV container had stale signatures locally and was restarted before processing succeeded; this is local environment state, not part of the change.
Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V and the inline fallback when attachments are blocked are covered by unit tests, not by the browser run.
designCommit and implementationCommit stay null until the change is committed.
notes: Promoted to current. The long-paste-attachment proposal entry, its --pasted-card-width tweak, the isProposal gate and the activeProposal tracking were removed; ChatPage always provides PastedTextContext and the composer card is a fixed 220px. The long-paste and over-limit scenes stay.
